mode_crown.name: Curator Mode: The Crown
mode_crown.description: Display mode 1 of the Curator's grammar: the room bows to one thing. A dark inverted canopy with a glowing underside hovers over the anchor's cell, a dais gathers the floor, a single downlight makes the object own its shadows. After the Grand Egyptian Museum. Configurable span/height; the anchor artifact is placed by the exhibition compiler.

mode_dialogue.name: Curator Mode: The Dialogue
mode_dialogue.description: Display mode 2: two works facing each other across a held axis, the tension sentence baked at the midpoint, cross-lights aiming each lamp at the opposite work. Stages heroes.json pairs. After the Worcester court. Config: gap, tension.

mode_witness_wall.name: Curator Mode: The Witness Wall
mode_witness_wall.description: Display mode 3: the commons ledger as a room. Reads doc/book/commons_sources.json LIVE at build time and bakes every pressed tradition (name, era) into columns on a dark wall, hush-lit, with a bench facing it. The wall grows when the ledger grows. After the 9/11 memorial hall - scale as feeling, credit as architecture.
